text.p: Signature Resorts Inc said on Monday it had agreed to acquire AVCOM International Inc, the parent company of All Seasons Resorts Inc, for about about $28.8 million in stock and the assumption of $22.6 million of AVCOM debt.
AVCOM develops and operates timeshare resorts in Arizona, California and Texas.
Under the merger agreement, Signature will issue about 1.48 million common shares in exchange for all outstanding AVCOM stock.

"All Seasons represents a strong compliment to our existing resort portfolio and operations. We believe All Seasons will significantly expand our ownership and resort base in the West," said Andrew Gessow, president of Signature.

The proposed merger will qualify as a pooling accounting treatment and remains subject to shareholder approval, satisfactory completion of due diligence by Signature, and other customary conditions, Signature said.
